Vishal Nirmiti IPO is a book build issue of ₹178.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 65.91 lakh shares aggregating to ₹145.00 crores and offer for sale of 15.00 lakh shares aggregating to ₹33.00 crores.

Vishal Nirmiti IPO opens for subscription on Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Oct 5, 2026. The allotment for the Vishal Nirmiti IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 6, 2026. Vishal Nirmiti IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 8, 2026.

Vishal Nirmiti IPO is set issue price band at ₹208 to ₹220 per share. The lot size for an application is 68 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,960 (68 shares) (based on upper price).

Saffron Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Vishal Nirmiti IPO RHP for detailed Information.

About Vishal Nirmiti Ltd.

Updated on Sep 26, 2026

Incorporated in 1994, Vishal Nirmiti Limited (formerly Sejal Farms Private Limited) is a civil engineering, manufacturing, and construction company primarily engaged in manufacturing and dealing of Pre-Stressed Concrete (PSC) sleepers for railways, pre-cast and pre-stressed concrete products, as well as fabrication and erection of Mild Steel (MS) pipes, liners, and penstock pipes for Pumped Storage Projects (PSPs).

The company also provides engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for railway infrastructure, irrigation, and civil engineering projects across sectors such as railways, renewable power, and industrial infrastructure.

Business Segments:

  • Manufacturing segment: Includes PSC sleeper manufacturing for Indian Railways, DFCCIL, and private clients, as well as MS pipes, MS liners, and penstock pipes for hydro power, lift irrigation, water supply, and infrastructure projects.

  • Services segment: Covers job work contracts for MS pipes, liners, penstock pipes, pre-cast and pre-stressed elements (such as noise barriers and cable ducts), hydro-mechanical structures, as well as construction works, power generation through windmills, transportation, leasing, and sale of scrap.

VNL has a pan-India presence with operational units across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Odisha, and Karnataka and is led by a highly experienced promoter group with over four decades of domain expertise

Competitive Strengths:

  • Execution capabilities with industry experience and strong operating systems, providing comprehensive solution.
  • Dedicated focus on railway infrastructure development and manufacture of PSC sleepers
  • Deeply entrenched, long term relationships with customers
  • Experienced Management Team driving the growth of the Company

IPO FAQs

Vishal Nirmiti IPO is a main-board IPO of 80,90,909 equity shares of the face value of ₹10 aggregating up to ₹178 Crores. The issue is priced at ₹208 to ₹220. The minimum order quantity is 68.

The IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026, and closes on Mon, Oct 5, 2026.

MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar for the IPO. The shares are proposed to be listed on BSE, NSE.

Zerodha customers can apply online in Vishal Nirmiti IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Vishal Nirmiti IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form.

Steps to apply in Vishal Nirmiti IPO through Zerodha

  1. Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console.
  2. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link.
  3. Go to the 'Vishal Nirmiti IPO' row and click the 'Bid' button.
  4. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price.
  5. Submit IPO application form.
  6. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM) to approve the mandate.

Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

The Vishal Nirmiti IPO opens on Wed, Sep 30, 2026 and closes on Mon, Oct 5, 2026.

Vishal Nirmiti IPO lot size is 68, and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,960.

You can apply in Vishal Nirmiti IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha, Upstox, 5Paisa, Nuvama, HDFC Bank, and SBI Bank.

The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Vishal Nirmiti IPO will be done on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Oct 7, 2026. Check the Vishal Nirmiti IPO allotment status.

The Vishal Nirmiti IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Oct 8, 2026.
